defectsResolved.defect: BLOCKING row 104: keep of a cylinder dipping 3 mm into a box side, radius 150-300, 9.8e-4 off
defectsResolved.how: Reproduced with closed forms (radius 100 to 500, depth 2.5 to 12 mm, plus held-out radius 110 to 700 at 3, 4 and 6 percent of the radius, cylinders lying down, round pull()). Kernel is 2.5e-4 off when the dip is deep enough, 9.8e-4 (3.3x the bar) for a shallower dip; r100 d2.5 is already 3.4e-4. G3 now refuses a dip under max(2 mm, 0.035 R). Every case the rule lets through is inside the bar, every failing case is refused. The 0.035 was chosen after seeing the sweep; the held-out r6h- set was run after and shows no built case over the bar. Cut and join of the same dips are fine (1.2e-5 to 8.8e-5) and have no rule.

defectsResolved.defect: BLOCKING row 66: tangent-to-two-sides cut passes as 'one body, several shells'; a later join leaves unfused faces; hole skips the one-piece refusal
defectsResolved.how: Reproduced: join after the pinched cut builds 3 shells and area 2.7e-2 off OCCT (opposite sides 1.7e-2) while volume is 5e-5 off. G7 now refuses a through-cylinder tangent to two or more sides (cases at three sizes, offset position, a cone), so every follow-on step (join, hole, cut) is skipped in one sentence; tangent to ONE side keeps building and its follow-on join and hole match OCCT (solid counts asserted equal). Near-tangent walls 0.01 to 1 mm and breaches 0.01 to 0.5 mm still build correctly; 0.0001, 0.001 walls and a 0.001 breach are refused (policy margin, labelled).

defectsResolved.defect: row 103 / big ball keep, bbox 5.8e-3 off (r200)
defectsResolved.how: New G19 compares the built bounding box with the operand boxes after the build (independent measure: an axis-aligned box operand is exact). r200 and r140-at-0.2R, plus larger cylinders (r700) and lying cylinders, are refused. Closed-form bbox on the ball cases shows which were really off. Over-refusal: some refused cases would have been inside the bar; the check cannot know.

Found that r4-coax-keep-partial-turned was NOT coaxial (second centre 10 mm off the y axis): it is a parallel-cylinder lens. The genuinely coaxial turned pairs (axes x, y, z, generic) are all refused by G17/G2. The lens class is refused by G20 after 14 closed-form lens cases showed 6 inside the bars and 8 outside with no size rule.

defectsResolved.defect: row 112 fuzz: four survivors discounted as OCCT artifacts with one second measure
defectsResolved.how: All four (fz13-037, fz23-005, fz23-050, fz7-067) now have a closed-form bounding box proof printed on their case lines (SolidCraft within the bar of it, OCCT outside). Survivors fz13-052 (lens, now G20) and fz17-023 (thin remainder, now G21) are guarded. Five seeds replayed under the final guard: 540 cases, 325 guard-refused, 209 matched, 1 kernel refusal, 1 wrong (fz23-087), 4 proven-loose-oracle, 0 hangs.
